title: The units package exports a new function, and no export guard covers it

pr.title: Add toMeters to the units package
pr.description: Adds toMeters(), which converts feet to meters, and exports it from the units package.

bugs.note: tests/exports.test.ts guards the export list of the sibling packages money and dates, but not of units. The change adds the export toMeters to units, and no guard checks the units exports. A later change can drop or add a units export without a failing test. Add a units entry to tests/exports.test.ts.

traps.why: Multiplying by 0.3048 is exact. A finding that it must divide is wrong.
